items.name: Northern Azerbaijan Decathlon 2018
items.information:
Şimal Dekatlon Yarışına xoş gəlmisiniz! Yarış iştirakçıların on kateqoriya üzrə xallar qazanacağı struktura əsaslanır. Yarış boyu ən çox xal toplamış yarışmaçı Şimal Dekatlon Çempionu olacaq. Xatırladaq ki, bu yarış adi DKA / WCA yarışı kimi olacaq. Dekatlon yarışı qeyri-rəsmidir.
___________
Ödəniş: 50 AZN. Kətlər daxil olmaqla 7 Şahdağ etnosu üçün pulsuz.  
___________

venue.name: Hira Hall - Sree Sindhi Guru Sangat Sabha
venue.address: 4-1-1106, YWCA Road, Bogulkunta, Hyderguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001, India

items.information:
Participants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 8th july 2018 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 5th july 2018 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 5th july 2018 9:00pm IST.
Please note once you register in WCA site for the Varsha Ritu Cube Open 2018, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation.
Additional information will be provided in the tabs.
